a.lede: Samsung's newly launched Odyssey G60H display is targeted squarely at serious competitive gamers with QHD 600Hz and HD 1100HZ display modes.
a.title: Samsung just launched a gaming monitor with a refresh rate higher than its price — dual-mode Odyssey G60H offers 1,100 Hz in HD

b.lede: Samsung’s Odyssey G8 G80SH is a 32-inch Quantum Dot OLED with 4K resolution and 240 Hz. It delivers a huge color gamut along with smooth and responsive gaming and it supports HDR10+ with dynamic tone mapping.
